description: Create a new indicator in DHIS2 called 'Malaria RDT Positivity Rate' that calculates the percentage of positive RDT results (Numerator: Malaria RDT positive / Denominator: Malaria RDT tested). Use the Maintenance app to create this indicator with the 'Percentage' indicator type (factor 100). Then, use the Data Visualizer app to create a bar chart showing this new indicator by District for 2023. Save the visualization as 'Malaria RDT Positivity by District 2023' and export the data to a CSV or Excel file in /home/ga/Downloads/.
